_comment: Activates brand-lint from the miragon-brand plugin (Claude Code hook and CI). The repo is English, so the German-only copy rules are off: du (A1), umlauts (A3), German passive (A4), German claim (A7), gender forms (A11) and C5 (one language per surface, German by default). Em dashes as connectors (A2), spellings (A10), the anti-slop patterns (S*), palette, token and dark-mode rules stay on. The docs kit in docs/.vitepress/miragon/ is linted at its source in Miragon/corporate-identity. Pictures a tool renders (docs/public/shots/, the bike-leasing model) keep the tool's colours.
